_doc: ADR-0069 D-E.6 / grill-t8 ledger D-006: the v3 contamination-registry FRAMEWORK, registered in the doc round before any v3 artifact exists. The T-3 freeze populates the v3 plan's contamination_registry with one row per registered parameter below; row shape mirrors the v1/v2 registry ({parameter, value, v2_informed, basis}) with the contamination axis shifted one generation. Values populated at the T-3 freeze (2026-09-16): each row now carries its registered value; the null form was the pre-freeze registration marker.
